text: 1-gene difference SplicingFactory (214 genes tested) TSENAT (213 genes tested) due subtle important difference two packages filter genes statistical testing. Implementation Difference: SplicingFactory’s Implementation: problematic line uses sum(x$cond_1, x$cond_2), sums values column vectors together, producing single scalar (approximately 1,040 case). Since global sum always >= 8, condition essentially always TRUE, filtering ineffective. TSENAT’s Implementation: TSENAT uses (df$cond_1 + df$cond_2), performs element-wise addition check individual gene’s total observation count. consequence TSENAT’s filter stricter: requires gene individually least 8 total observations (3 one group, 3 , plus 2 either group). SplicingFactory’s filter effectively doesn’t work Wilcoxon test global sum condition almost never FALSE.

code: # Create test analysis with appropriate sample structure for paired design # Note: requires lme4 package for LMM fitting; uses synthetic data set.seed(42)  # Create transcript-level counts with biological signal # Note: Use adequate complexity (transcripts/genes, samples, expression)  # to avoid filtering away all genes during diversity computation n_genes <- 50 n_transcripts_per_gene <- 30 n_transcripts <- n_genes * n_transcripts_per_gene n_samples <- 16  # title: Detect q-dependent gene interactions — calculate_rank_test
text: ## Key Features - **Q×Condition Interaction**: Tests entropy patterns across q-values differ   condition (main discovery goal) - **Multi-q Analysis**: Combines diversity results multiple q-values   single SummarizedExperiment joint hypothesis testing - **Rank-Based Statistics**: Kruskal-Wallis (unpaired) Friedman (paired) - **Scheirer-Ray-Hare Test**: Two-way non-parametric ANOVA ranks - **Multiple Testing Correction**: Hochberg, Benjamini-Yekutieli, permutation   (Westfall-Young) procedures - **AR(1) Correlation Handling**: Westfall-Young preserves q-value spatial   correlations (important ordered q measurements) - **Effect Sizes**: Eta-squared (\(\eta^2\)) q×condition interactions ## Statistical Hypotheses Tests null hypothesis: - H0 = Gene entropy q-effect differ conditions (q-independent) - H1 = Gene entropy q-dependence CONDITION-SPECIFIC (interaction exists) significant interaction indicates condition-specific patterns entropy varies across q-value spectrum, revealing biological processes specific condition. ## Biological Example Gene shows strong isoform switching (q-dependent entropy) tumor cells healthy cells → Identified disease-relevant q-dependent gene. condition-specific q-dependent genes: - **Condition **: Strong entropy variation across q (q-dependent isoform usage) - **Condition B**: Flat entropy profile across q (uniform isoform usage) - **Interaction**: Condition-specific q-dependence pattern reveals disease-associated   splicing regulation Analyzes gene interactions change across q-value spectrum using rank-based (Friedman/Kruskal-Wallis) parametric (GAM) statistical tests. **Parameter resolution priority** (explicit > @config > default/auto-detect): condition_col: REQUIRED - must explicitly provided q: ALWAYS auto-detected diversity_results (q-values tested together) paired: explicit arg > @config$paired > FALSE (default) subject_col: explicit arg > @config$subject_col multicorr:  explicit arg > @config$multicorr > 'hochberg' nthreads: explicit arg > @config$nthreads > 1 (default) test:  explicit arg > @config$test > 'auto' (auto-selection) nperm_mode:  explicit arg > @config$nperm_mode > 'standard'

code: # Load example data data(readcounts, package = 'TSENAT')  # Create TSENATAnalysis from count matrix config <- TSENAT_config(   q = 1.0,   condition_col = 'group' ) se <- SummarizedExperiment::SummarizedExperiment(   assays = list(counts = readcounts),   colData = data.frame(     group = rep(c('A', 'B'), length.out = ncol(readcounts))   ) ) analysis <- TSENATAnalysis(se = se, config = config) analysis <- calculate_diversity(analysis) #> [calculate_diversity] Using q = 1.000 (config) #> Warning: [calculate_diversity] Assay for q=1 is empty  # Get all diversity results (list of SummarizedExperiment objects, one per q) div_all <- results(analysis, type = 'diversity')  # Get diversity for specific q-value (single SummarizedExperiment) div_q1 <- results(analysis, type = 'diversity', q = 1.0)  # Get results ranked by p-value, top 20 genes # Using accessor function instead of @ slot access top_lm <- results(analysis, type = 'lm', rankBy = 'pvalue', n = 20)  # Get pairwise results (e.g., differential diversity metrics between conditions) pairwise_diff <- results(analysis, type = 'pairwise')  # Get effect size results, top 6 genes by p-value (most significant first) top_effect_sizes <- results(analysis, type = 'effect_sizes_divergence',                               top_n = 6, sort_by = 'adj_p_interaction')  # Get effect sizes sorted by mean divergence (largest effect sizes first) large_effects <- results(analysis, type = 'effect_sizes_divergence',                          top_n = 10, sort_by = 'Mean_Divergence')  # Get switching tables - automatically computed if prerequisites exist # (no need to call prepare_gene_switching_tables_s4 separately) switching <- results(analysis, type = 'switching_tables')

title: TSENAT 0.99.0
text: Initial Bioconductor release. TSENAT provides scale-dependent analysis transcript isoform diversity using Tsallis entropy, enabling detection splicing-driven regulatory changes orthogonal count-based differential expression methods. Core analysis via calculate_diversity() / calculate_diversity(), calculate_difference() / calculate_difference(), calculate_divergence() / calculate_divergence(), calculate_lm_interaction() / calculate_lm_interaction_s4() supporting diverse statistical tests (Wilcoxon, Friedman, permutation, jackknife bootstrap). Parameter q tunes Tsallis entropy sensitivity: q < 1 emphasizes rare isoforms, q ≈ 1 recovers Shannon entropy, q > 1 emphasizes dominant isoforms. Unified S4 class TSENATAnalysis integrating SummarizedExperiment, configuration, results, cached plots full subsetting accessor support. Data input: read_salmon_samples() direct Salmon/Sailfish quantification import GFF3 annotation parsing. Quality control: filter_analysis() multi-criteria filtering; jackknife_entropy_outliers_s4() outlier detection. Visualization suite (8 plot types): diversity q-curves, volcano/MA plots, violin/density plots, transcript composition heatmaps, divergence distance matrices, interaction surfaces, concordance plots, multi-gene q-spectrum plots. ggplot2-based publication-ready styling. High-level workflow orchestration via TSENAT() flexible configuration management TSENAT_config(). Performance: Rcpp/RcppArmadillo entropy calculations, BiocParallel support, lazy-loading visualization libraries (~30% faster non-plot workflows). Comprehensive documentation: main vignette + 2 appendices (SplicingFactory validation, advanced workflows), 46 exported functions complete roxygen2 documentation.
